title: Construction-Period Interest Rate and Permanent Rate Lock, Construction Loans
content:
The interest rate on Construction Loans during construction is a variable rate built on the Association Variable Base Rate.

## Rule

The construction-period rate is the Association Variable Base Rate in effect on the closing date, as registered under the rate setting of the Operating Lines of Credit, plus the product's rate spread, rounded to 3 decimal places and not lower than the product's rate floor; it moves with each later base-rate history date for loans in active, extended or converting status. An extension does not change the spread. For a single-close product the permanent rate quoted at closing is held for the product's permanent rate lock period in months; for the others the permanent rate is set at conversion under the permanent product's own charter.

## The rate as a quantity

The construction-period rate is the Association Variable Base Rate in effect on the date concerned, increased by the product's spread in percentage points, with that total rounded to 3 decimal places; where the rounded figure is below the product's rate floor, the rate is the floor. On the closing date the base rate used is the one in effect on that date; each later base-rate history date sets the rate anew, by the same construction, for a loan in active, extended or converting status.

## Worked rates (hypothetical base rates and product figures)

| Base rate in effect | Spread | Total | Rounded to 3 decimals | Floor | Construction-period rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5.1234% | 0.50 points | 5.6234% | 5.623% | 5.50% | 5.623% |
| 4.80% | 0.75 points | 5.55% | 5.550% | 5.75% | 5.75% (the floor) |

## Points of judgement

- *Does an extension of the construction period alter the rate?* The spread stays as it was; the rate continues to follow later base-rate history dates while the loan is in extended status.
- *When is the permanent rate fixed?* On a single-close product, the permanent rate quoted at the construction closing is held for the product's permanent rate lock period. On the other products it is set at conversion under the permanent product's own charter.
